category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations

formulations.name: Parameterized PINN
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Conditions a single network on physical or design parameters.
formulations.purpose: Represents a family of related PDE/ODE solutions without retraining from scratch for every parameter.
formulations.relation: It enlarges the canonical input space from coordinates to coordinates plus parameters.

formulations.name: Conditional residual over a parameter family
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Evaluates physics for multiple parameterized problem instances.
formulations.purpose: Extends residual training from one problem to a conditional family.
formulations.relation: It is the physics-enforcement counterpart of the parameterized PINN input.

formulations.name: Hypernetwork-generated PINN parameters
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Uses a hypernetwork to generate the parameters of a coordinate network from problem parameters.
formulations.purpose: Separates parameter-to-model mapping from coordinate-to-field evaluation.
formulations.relation: It is a reusable conditional representation related to parameterized PINNs.

formulations.name: Reduced-basis PINN representation
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Represents the solution in a low-dimensional basis while learning the reduced coefficients.
formulations.purpose: Reduces field dimensionality and repeated computational cost.
formulations.relation: It bridges PINNs and projection/reduced-order methods.

formulations.name: POD-coordinate surrogate
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Predicts proper-orthogonal-decomposition coordinates and reconstructs the physical field.
formulations.relation: It uses a data/numerics-derived basis while preserving physics-informed constraints where defined.

formulations.name: Solution operator
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Defines the target of operator learning as a map between function spaces.
formulations.purpose: Changes the learning object from one solution function to a reusable solution operator.
formulations.relation: Physics-informed operator methods impose governing relations on this reusable map.
formulations.symbols: \(\mathcal{A}\): input-function space; \(\mathcal{U}\): solution-function space; \(\mathcal{G}\): solution operator.

formulations.name: DeepONet branch–trunk representation
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Combines a branch encoding of an input function with a trunk encoding of the query coordinate.
formulations.relation: It is the canonical DeepONet-type representation underlying several physics-informed operator variants.
formulations.symbols: \(b_{\theta,k}\): branch features; \(t_{\theta,k}\): trunk features; \(\mathbf{y}\): query coordinate; \(p\): latent width.

formulations.name: Physics-informed DeepONet residual
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Applies the governing operator to the output of a learned solution operator.
formulations.purpose: Physics-regularizes operator learning and can reduce reliance on paired solution data.
formulations.relation: It extends the canonical PINN residual from one field to a family of fields.

formulations.name: Separable operator representation
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.purpose: Reduces the computational cost of evaluating high-dimensional operator outputs.
formulations.relation: It modifies the trunk representation while preserving operator learning.

formulations.name: Fourier neural-operator layer
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Combines a local linear map with a learned spectral convolution.
formulations.purpose: Implements field-to-field operator learning in Fourier space.
formulations.relation: It is a reusable operator architecture distinct from an instance-wise coordinate PINN.
formulations.symbols: \(\mathcal{F}\), \(\mathcal{F}^{-1}\): Fourier transform and inverse; \(R_\ell\): learned spectral multiplier.

formulations.name: Physics-informed Fourier-operator objective
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Combines operator data fitting with governing-equation consistency.
formulations.relation: It parallels the canonical PINN composite objective at operator scale.
formulations.symbols: \(\mathbb{E}_{a,\mathbf{y}}\): average over input functions and evaluation coordinates.

formulations.name: Multi-fidelity operator correction
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Combines a low-fidelity operator prediction with a learned correction toward higher fidelity.
formulations.purpose: Uses heterogeneous fidelity levels to reduce expensive training data requirements.
formulations.relation: It extends reusable operator learning with explicit fidelity structure.
formulations.symbols: \(\mathcal{G}^{L}\): low-fidelity operator; \(\Delta\mathcal{G}\): learned correction; \(u_H\): high-fidelity target.

formulations.name: Stacked operator composition
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.purpose: Supports progressive refinement of a functional mapping.
formulations.relation: It changes operator depth/organization rather than reverting to one-solution PINN training.
formulations.symbols: \(S\): number of operator stages; \(\circ\): functional composition.

formulations.name: Family-averaged operator loss
formulations.category: F · Parameterized, reduced, and operator-learning formulations
formulations.meaning: Optimizes one model across a distribution of input functions or PDE instances.
formulations.purpose: Formalizes amortized learning over a problem family.
formulations.relation: It is the operator analogue of the canonical composite PINN loss.
formulations.symbols: \(\mathcal{P}_A\): training distribution over input functions/problem instances.
